releaseNote:
修复 Windows 绿色版环境自检和 C++20 编译时找不到标准库头文件的问题，自动修复已有编译配置并保留自定义选项。工作区直接受信任，不再进入受限模式；浏览界面双击顶部标签栏空白处会打开新的空白浏览器标签页。

Fixed missing standard-library headers during environment checks and C++20 compilation in the Windows portable edition. Existing compiler settings are repaired automatically while preserving custom options. Workspaces are trusted automatically, and double-clicking empty space in the browsing tab bar opens a new blank browser tab.
